Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/29/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 265 as introduced provides for an additional Level III deputy district attorney in the Tenth Judicial Circuit, Bessemer Division, which will increase the financial obligations of the Jefferson County Commission to provide compensation in an amount ranging from $38,000 to $54,500, annually dependent upon the level and step in which the deputy district attorney is hired.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/04/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 265 as passed the Senate provides for an additional Level III deputy district attorney in the Tenth Judicial Circuit, Bessemer Division, which will increase the financial obligations of the Jefferson County Commission to provide compensation in an amount ranging from $38,000 to $54,500, annually, plus fringe benefits, dependent upon the level and step on the pay scale where the deputy district attorney is appointed.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/06/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 265 as amended and reported by the Committee on Judiciary provides for an additional Level III deputy district attorney in the Tenth Judicial Circuit, Bessemer Division, which could increase the financial obligations of the Jefferson County Commission, subject to approval of the Commission, to provide compensation in an amount ranging from $38,000 to $54,500, annually, plus fringe benefits, dependent upon the level and step on the pay scale where the deputy district attorney is appointed.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
